fib: ______ is a method of literary criticism which assumes that language refers only to itself rather than to an extra textual reality and which asserts multiple conflicting interpretations of a text.

Deconstruction is a method of literary criticism which assumes that language refers only to itself rather than to an extra textual reality and which asserts multiple conflicting interpretations of a text.
______ is a kind of criticism whereby a work of literature is assessed and judged according to its portrayal of a society.
Sociological criticism is a kind of criticism whereby a work of literature is assessed and judged according to its portrayal of a society.
______ is the servant of the sea god, Poseidon.
Proteus in Greek mythology is the servant of the sea god, Poseidon.
______ are regarded as the creation of writers.
Characters' behaviour and actions are regarded as the creation of writers.
______ is the store house of the memories that the conscious part of the mind allows to be brought to consciousness without disguising these memories in some form or another.
The preconscious is the store house of the memories that the conscious part of the mind allows to be brought to consciousness without disguising these memories in some form or another.
______ is regarded as the main founder of Western philosophy.
Plato is regarded as the main founder of Western philosophy.
